description: Fetch the lyrics of one track from LRCLIB, given the id returned by search_tracks, or an exact artist and title. Set 'format' to "synced" for karaoke-style lyrics with a timestamp on every line, "plain" for the text alone, or "both". Check 'has_synced_lyrics' in the search results first: not every track has timed lyrics. Lyrics can be long, so the text is truncated by default: check 'truncated' and call again with 'offset' set to 'next_offset' to continue reading. Instrumental tracks come back with status "instrumental" and no text, which is a valid answer, so do not retry them. Always cite 'attribution' when showing lyrics to a user.

album_name.description: Album name, to pick between releases.

artist_name.description: Artist name, matched exactly by LRCLIB. Required when 'id' is absent.

duration_seconds.description: Track duration, to pick between versions of differing length.

format.description: 'plain' returns the text only. 'synced' returns LRC text plus a parsed list of timestamped lines. 'both' returns each of them.

id.description: LRCLIB track id, as returned by search_tracks. Preferred over the name fields.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of lyrics text to return in this call.

offset.description: Character offset to resume from, for lyrics longer than max_chars.

track_name.description: Song title, matched exactly by LRCLIB. Required when 'id' is absent.

name: get_lyrics

paginated_form.description: Which body the character counts and the offset describe. Timed text carries its timestamps, so it is longer than the words alone.

synced_lyrics.description: Raw LRC text, one timestamp per line.

title: Get lyrics
